full_judgment: 25. The learned District Judge has held that the transfer of the shares of the petitioner in favour of his brother is void because no written consent of the other partners were obtained. The burden of proof was upon the opposite party No. 1 to show that no such consent was obtained because it was he who wanted the Court to believe the same. The opposite party No. 1 did not discharge that burden of proof. In partnership matters the other partners may not give prior consent to the sale of shares by one partner but they can always ratify the act and there is nothing in law preventing the other partners from doing the same. Therefore these are matters between partners and certainly the Election Tribunal or the Appellate Court is not the forum for determination of such questions in the absence of the partners.
